list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026 (names, descriptions and grades agree on both). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. No online trophies.
sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades come from the official list as published on Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). PSN progress targets (the counts) are from PSNProfiles. How-to detail is drawn from PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com, 18 Nov 2026) and rewritten in our own words; where PowerPyx marks a trophy as not yet known, the guide says so and works from the official description alone. See app/data/sources.json.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Everything in this guide leads here, and the roadmap view lays out the order: story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies at all.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops at the mission's end. You cannot miss it — just play the story. PowerPyx lists it as the first mission of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish every main mission of Chapter 1. The chapter ends when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins (What's in the Bag?), so keep following the pink main-mission markers. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 2 in full. The chapter closes as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. This is also the chapter where you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia (after the Coffee Break mission) and the partner mechanics that several later trophies need.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 3. Its first missions are Ocean Beach and Another Life, per PowerPyx, and the chapter is where several side questlines open up — Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's — so take the calls and texts as they come. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 4, whose final main mission is Starting From Zero. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes and the story moves on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Gold, automatic: finish the game's final mission. The story is five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours, according to PowerPyx, and after the credits you return to free-roam, so everything left over can still be done. Keep cheats off the whole way — using one disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just follow the mission marker when it appears; the trophy pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist, so play it when the marker appears; no special objective is needed for the trophy beyond finishing the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Play the mission through to its end; the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the last story missions, so it pops late in the run; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy on the list by PowerPyx's ranking. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts, so start early. The checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and of the things that are, you usually need only 70–80% (scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, complete any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions). What does need everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Silver. Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, across four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick the easiest — PowerPyx calls under-the-bridge flights the quickest. Track progress by region in the Progress menu under Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this trophy comes on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 9 activity types, and you need one of each. Open the Progress menu (touchpad), then Activities, to see the nine and how many of each you have done. The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or by unfogging the map, and the blue dumbbell icons on the map mark activity spots; you will likely finish this naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. There are 12 shooting range locations holding 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal. The ranges are also on the 100% checklist, so they are not optional. PowerPyx calls the gold medals not too difficult; take them steadily as you unlock ranges rather than leaving all 42 for the end. The full range list is in PowerPyx's shooting range guide, linked in the sources.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations (42 drone races in total) and you need a win at each of the 14. The races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy arrives on the way to the platinum. Race locations are listed in PowerPyx's Top Fun guide, linked in the sources.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. There are 40 unique race locations in the game, per PowerPyx, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the activity types; pick the short, easy ones first and save the harder circuits for the 100% checklist, which wants more racing anyway.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a friend you meet in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time after that mission he texts you, marking a fishing spot with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline from there. Fishing itself is one of the nine activity types, so the challenge also feeds Master of None. If the text has not arrived yet, keep playing the story; it comes after Feng Shui, not before.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: There are four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. To complete one, finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline opens in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as her you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Five quests follow — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission where you work for him; he calls, then appears under a green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasure with the metal detector and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason he texts you; calling Brian as Jason can speed it up). Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests follow: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. The trophy pops on the last one, and all five stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Strangers & Freaks are open-world side quests, but only certain questlines count — the big optional character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands, per PowerPyx: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-racing mentor quests) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries). You need any 8 strands, and more strangers are still being found, so check the strangers guide linked in the sources. All are still there after the story. Track the count on the trophy itself in the PSN trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner for high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City): the Zorrusso is already delivered by the story, then the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for more pay. Track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. All doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City; go and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one PowerPyx flags, and only as potentially missable, so do this one early. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 (each spot counts twice in the Progress menu, under Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations). You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The catch is Chapter 1: at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That home meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, and it becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1; PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it — this line is Jason-only). He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Silver. Collectible cards are found around Leonida in sets, and you need three complete sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 card set locations — use it, because cards are small and easy to walk past. Only three sets are needed for the trophy even though more exist, so pick the sets whose locations are closest together. The cards also feed the 100% checklist's collectible requirements.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver. WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1 on the phone's WAiNK app: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, with more than 100 in total, so any 100 count. Scan as you travel rather than hunting them down in one trip — you will pass most of them during the story and the vehicle-scanning for Whip It Good. The same app scans vehicles, so keep it on the quick-use key.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in the game and you need any 50 — pick the easiest. Track them under Progress, then Challenges; each one shows a checkmark when done. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, which needs any 70 of 80, so leave this for late and then mop up the quickest remaining ones. PowerPyx's challenge guide, linked in the sources, lists all 80.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available from Chapter 2, after Coffee Break unlocks playing together: call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle, then build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops when you drive out of the heat, not just out of the flashing search area. Easiest escape: a fast sports bike, cutting through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. You will likely get this for free during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the big bank vault robberies it unlocks always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Also from Chapter 2, after Coffee Break: with your partner called in (hold Right, press Triangle), rob three robbery targets in a row while the wanted level never drops — keep the red-and-blue flashing wanted level alive the whole time, never the red heat level. Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the pop is delayed (it can take half a minute after leaving the third shop) hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and you need to discover any 100. Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The fastest method is standing on a busy road and scanning everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy comes automatically on that road. Check your totals under the touchpad menu, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You need five enemies down in one single use, so set it up: buff focus first with food, drinks, or a wash/shower at home, and pop Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow-time window. Line up five enemies — criminals at gang operations work; soldiers, police and civilians reportedly do not count — and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you reach Focus level 4 this gets much easier, and it may pop naturally during the other trophies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get straight inside (or walk in through the terminal). Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out, so bring armor and a plan to leave fast.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory, no need to equip it — instead of kicking the door, which trips the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver. Bank vault robberies open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open after the guard carries the briefcase in, and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip for security van locations (after his earlier quests, robbing two Payday Loans). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this trophy comes on the way; each vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests — then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist anyway, so it will come on its own.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: PSN tracks 52 areas: you need the whole map unfogged. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible. Do it late, after the story, when you can fly freely and the whole map is open; every area you reveal also helps the vehicle and WAiNK scanning trophies, since you will spot new things on the way. PowerPyx links a guide to unfogging the map fast with the best plane.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you need just one operation from each gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically if you are going for the platinum. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method had been published by 18 November 2026 — so this guide works from the official description alone and marks it honestly. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: look for a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach where you can order or sit with a drink and take in the view, and try it in free-roam after the story, when the whole map is open. We have not pinned the exact spot, and this entry does not pretend otherwise; check PowerPyx's guide, linked in the sources, for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method had been published by 18 November 2026 — so this guide works from the official description alone and marks it honestly. The description points at a vehicle showroom: find a car dealership or showroom in Vice City, get inside in a vehicle, and smash your way out through the glass in classic GTA style. Try it in free-roam with a sturdy car and an escape route planned, and check PowerPyx's guide, linked in the sources, for the confirmed spot once it is published.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is tied to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — one of the 39 illegal operations — which you visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside the bowling alley, steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, blown open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left — it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This pops when both Jason and Lucia are at maximum strength at the same time. Check strength under the touchpad menu, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then Strength (the heart icon). Available from Chapter 2, after Coffee Break lets you switch characters: buy a fitness club membership, always go together (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner), and while one character works out the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Filter fitness clubs on the map under Activities. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count to 500: you need 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile — a little demon face appears at the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The five profile rungs are Professional (stealthy objectives and clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid piling up excessive violence if you do not want cops shooting on sight. It accrues passively through robberies and encounters, so you will likely get it while working on everything else; if it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — so treat that as a lead, not a fact. The description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt: if you visit the Payday Loans store early, pay attention to anything that can be tried twice, and if a first attempt at something there fails, try it again rather than moving on. This guide works from the official description and PowerPyx's note alone; check the linked guide for the confirmed method once it is published.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, believed to be from a UFO questline — so treat that as a lead, not a fact. The description reads like a reaction to something strange: keep an eye out for odd, out-of-place events while exploring Leonida at night and in remote spots, and follow any strange quest thread you stumble on rather than dismissing it. This guide works from the official description and PowerPyx's note alone; check the linked guide for the confirmed method once it is published.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — so treat that as a lead, not a fact. The description points at a melee drive-by: on a motorcycle, ride past an enemy and strike them with a melee attack (or kick) as you pass, bowling them over. Try it on slow-moving pedestrians or enemies in open areas where you can line up the pass, and keep at it if the first passes do not register. This guide works from the official description and PowerPyx's note alone; check the linked guide for the confirmed method once it is published.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one delivery. Bank vaults alone can give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, so this trophy builds naturally through the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — every shop in the game counts toward the one total, and PSN tracks the running sum. This comes naturally if you buy what the other trophies ask for: weapons and armor at Ammu-Nation, sticky bombs, fitness club memberships, vehicles and clothes. If it is still short near the end, the fastest top-up is buying expensive items at Ammu-Nation or a high-end vehicle. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so money is rarely the bottleneck by the time you are cleaning up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Properties are bought through the in-game property or real-estate listings — check the map and your phone for garage properties for sale, and buy them as you can afford them; vault robberies (up to $205,000 each) make the late ones easy. PSN tracks the count to 8, so you can see how many you still need. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect for the vehicle trophies.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register any 10 vehicles to it — PSN tracks the count to 10. Any vehicles count, so use the ones you already own or drive regularly; registering is quick and free, and you can do it from the start of the game. If you are working on Whip It Good at the same time, scan each new vehicle with WAiNK first, then register it, so one vehicle feeds two trophies.
trophies.name: On the Spot
